note: Palo Alto County Conservation Board campground in Lost Island - Huston Park, 3 mi north of Ruthven on the NE side of Lost Island Lake (1,200 acres). The full-hookup sites are lots 1, 2 and 17-24. The park has a swimming beach with dock, a boat ramp, fishing docks, hiking trails and the Lost Island Nature Center; extra vehicles park at the nature center lot. --Claude
summary: Rate now recorded: $25 electric/water, $30 full hookup (2026 rules). Confirmed 24 sites, water at all and sewer at some, showers/flush toilets/dump, May 15-Oct 15, no reservations; added the 14-night limit. Not waterfront stands. Amperage not posted.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. The county's trail map labels 'HUSTON Campground' NE of the nature-center (LINC) parking lot, east of 350th Ave; on imagery that is a tree-lined loop road (~43.1769,-94.8906) set back ~100-150 m from the shore, with the park road, a paved trail and an unbroken wooded shore belt between it and the lake. No site faces open water and no view through the woods is evident; the county shows no campsite photos. Imagery is leaf-off spring with no RVs parked, so individual pads cannot be seen; distances are imagery estimates (Overpass down).

PIN: the stored 43.17850,-94.89100 sits at the shore parking/ramp area ~170 m NW of the loop I read as the campground (~43.1769,-94.8906). Under the ~250 m threshold, and I could not see pads to pin precisely, so no move proposed. The stored note's 'corrected to the lakeside camping loop' did not match what imagery shows at the pin, so it was dropped from the note. Google's park pin (43.1776,-94.8877) is in the farm field east of the park.
HOOKUPS: amperage is not posted anywhere the county publishes; electric left unset. Phone (712) 837-4866 and both website lines confirmed (the county site is the operator's).
